modules.module_title: prepare raw materials required for making the master model

pcs.pc_description: identify raw materials like ball clay, mud clay, black clay, plaster of paris, etc. for making the master model.
collect required raw materials and tools like a chisel, fine pen, sieve in prescribed quantities
prepare collected clay by breaking down solid pieces of mud and blend it with water prior to the casting stage by using appropriate tools like blender, hammer, etc.
perform the sieving process of blended mixture using sieve of fine mesh to remove tiny stone pieces
explain the importance of letting dry sieved mixture for two days to make it of right consistency
arrange raw materials carefully for further usage in making appropriate master model
deliver remaining raw material to the designated storage locations

modules.module_title: perform the standard process of master model making

pcs.pc_description: perform the standard process for creating a master model to create mould for casting either by plaster of paris or clay
perform the process of placing a lump on the turning wheel
demonstrate the process of shaping clay on the turning wheel
demonstrate the process of giving basic shape to master model by hands.
provide correct stance and detailing to master model using sculpting tools like a chisel, sharp pen, etc.
prepare slurry like mixture of plaster of paris, cement and water for making mould.
ensure removing extra materials sticking to the mould using a chisel once the mould is dried.
demonstrate the standard process of dusting chalk powder inside mould to avoid sticking of clay cavities

modules.module_title: perform the standard process of master model making by using electric wheel

pcs.pc_description: select high-quality clay and ensure all tools are within reach
knead the clay thoroughly to remove air bubbles and achieve a smooth consistency
place the clay on the electric wheel and center it by pressing it down and inward with steady hands
use shaping tools (like ribs and sponges) to smooth and refine the surface

modules.module_title: check master model quality and productivity standards

pcs.pc_description: inspect master model based on the quality standard parameters to ensure the master model is created as per standard procedures
ensure no excess clay is chipped to master model
maintain records of inspection results/tests
ensure that there is no wastage of materials
prepare a sample template to collect information during inspection based on master model
ensure there are no process delays
achieve periodical targets set by the supervisor
